name: The Reed Loft
hint: A reed keeps breathing: hit it (A or B) and it sends a wave every beat for a few beats. The fork in the slot only rings while waves keep reaching it. Set the reed going, then run.

solution.why: set the reed breathing: eight waves, a beat apart, down the slot to the chord fork, which holds the chamber door open
run into the chamber while the door is held (about 11 tiles, a couple of seconds)
the second Overtone: three waves at once
light the fork in the chamber: the south door opens, a shortcut home to the start, and so does the chamber's side door
